newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ebos to buy Richard Thomson for A$3.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ebos to buy Richard Thomson for A$3.6 mln.

text.p: Medical supplies company Ebos Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement to buy New South Wales medical wholesaler Richard Thomson and Co Pty Ltd for A$3.57 million.
The total is made up of A$2.4 million cash plus an issue of 250,000 Ebos ordinary shares valued at A$1.17 million. Ebos shares last traded at NZ$5.95 on December 6.
Ebos shareholders will be asked to approve the purchase at an extraordinary general meeting on December 23. Ebos will also seek approval at that meeting for a share scheme for senior executives.
